seeded_vulnerabilities.title: Unparameterized SQL Query in User Directory Lookup
seeded_vulnerabilities.remediation_requirement: Replace f-string SQL query construction with parameterized ? placeholder tuple.

seeded_vulnerabilities.title: Missing Role Authorization in Confidential Document Export
seeded_vulnerabilities.remediation_requirement: Enforce explicit role check ensuring requester_role == 'admin' before querying confidential documents.

seeded_vulnerabilities.title: Unescaped HTML Output in Directory Search Banner
seeded_vulnerabilities.remediation_requirement: Sanitize filter_label with html.escape(filter_label, quote=True) prior to HTML interpolation.

seeded_vulnerabilities.title: Production Debug Mode, Verbose Stack Traces, and Static Secret Mode Enabled
seeded_vulnerabilities.remediation_requirement: Disable DEBUG_MODE and EXPOSE_STACK_TRACES in production and set TOKEN_SIGNING_MODE to 'ephemeral_rotatable_key'.
